from itertools import permutations
dist = [[0, 12, 10, 19], [12, 0, 3, 7], [10, 3, 0, 6], [19, 7, 6, 0]]
best = min(permutations(range(1, 4)),
           key=lambda p: dist[0][p[0]] + dist[p[0]][p[1]] + dist[p[1]][p[2]] + dist[p[2]][0])
print(best)

from itertools import product
edges = [(0, 1), (1, 2), (2, 3), (3, 0), (0, 2)]
best = max(product([0, 1], repeat=4), key=lambda s: sum(s[a] != s[b] for a, b in edges))
print("groups:", best)
